defects.title: Staff locked out of car/location :id agency routes (agency selector poisoned by resource id)
defects.rootCause: agencyAuthorization.requestedSupplierId treats req.params.id as a supplier candidate. On routes whose :id is a car/location id (delete-car, check-car, validate-car-license-plate, update/delete-car-image, update/delete-location, check-location, update/delete-location-image), a staff request resolves its agency context against the resource id, finds no membership, and 403s at requireAgencyPermission - regardless of the role capabilities in rolePermissions (Manager holds ManageFleet/ManageLocations; every staff role with ReadFleet/ReadLocations was equally blocked). Admin (bypass) and the supplier Owner (requested selector ignored) were unaffected, proven live in A3a/A3b. The approval decide route already carried a documented pinAgencySelector workaround for this exact trap; car/location routes had none.
defects.fix: Added the same pinAgencySelector middleware (copied from approvalRoutes) after authJwt.verifyToken on the :id routes of backend/src/routes/carRoutes.ts (checkCar, validateCarLicensePlate, delete, updateImage, deleteImage) and backend/src/routes/locationRoutes.ts (update, delete, checkLocation, updateImage, deleteImage). Backend build exit 0 (185 files); compiled carRoutes.js + locationRoutes.js layered via docker cp + container restart; health 200.

observations.topic: location delete has no in-use guard
observations.detail: DELETE of a location still referenced by a car returned 200; car read-back after delete: {"locations":["6aedceebbcb3c1762c7d3f1e"],"status":200}. Behaviour recorded per task instruction; no policy decision exists for delete guards, so no behaviour change made.

supplierRoutes.config exposes validate/update/delete/get only; a new agency (supplier) cannot be created through the API surface used by the admin app flows exercised here. Supplier assignment coherence was therefore walked via car.supplier (create + reassignment read-backs, step F4) and the Apex profile no-op update (step M5).

Live matrix: manager recordPayment = 403 while counterAgent and accountant pass the permission layer (404 on a fake booking). This matches rolePermissions in agencyAuthorization.ts (Manager has ReadPayments + DecideInvoices but not RecordPayments). No decided rule covers manager payment recording (decision 1.5 decided counter-agent record-pending only), so current behaviour is recorded, not changed.

observations.topic: ReadOnly reads finance data in full
observations.detail: Live matrix: readOnly reports 200, paymentsList 200, invoicesList 200, cashSessionsList 200 - full read access with no redaction. Read-only export redaction is an owner-open item (decision-pack role matrix items 2-5 carried no default), so current behaviour is recorded, not changed.

CounterAgent: reports 403 and paymentsList 403 (no ReadPayments) while recordPayment and cash movement creation pass and land as pending until an accountant-or-above confirms (M3/M4) - exactly the decided 1.5 pattern. Recorded as coherent.

GET /api/agency-memberships/current returned 200 for manager and 403 for counterAgent/accountant/mechanic/readOnly (requireAgencyMemberRead allows Owner/Manager only, per GESTIONAUTO-MAP team page: manager/owner read). Staff below manager cannot read even their own membership record through this route. Recorded as current behaviour; no decision covers it.

POST /api/frontend-cars and /api/frontend-suppliers return 400 for minimal payloads; both require the full GetCarsPayload filter set (carType/gearbox/mileage/fuelPolicy/deposit/ranges/... plus suppliers + pickupLocation + from/to), which the storefront always sends. With the full payload both return 200 and the fixture car/supplier (A3d, F2b). API-contract observation, not a defect.

observations.topic: Car delete guard for booking history (by design)
observations.detail: carController.deleteCar refuses (409) when the car has any bookings: "Vehicles with booking history are retired, not deleted." Cleanup therefore deletes bookings before cars, as in B1/B2. Location delete has no equivalent guard (O1/F5b): the raw locations array on cars keeps the deleted id while populated views and storefront search cope (0 results). No decision covers location delete guards; recorded, not changed.

The platform admin session operated across the Apex agency for every action in this walk (agencyAuth maps Admin to an Owner context for any requested supplier). Platform-admin support-access terms are an owner-open item (decision-pack role matrix items 2-5); current behaviour recorded, not changed.

Deleting a staff user removes its AgencyMembership rows (verified: after cleanup the Apex membership list is empty, including memberships that were suspended first). Note for the coordinator: B2 disclosed suspended memberships as residue; if B2 cleanup deleted its staff users through the same route, that residue may likewise already be gone - worth a one-line verification against the B2 artifact.

notes: F2/F3 initial FAIL was a harness payload defect (frontend-cars requires the full filter payload; minimal body -> 400). Re-proven as F2b with the B1-proven payload shape: car visible on the customer frontend at the updated name/price. Not an app defect.

P2 verdict basis corrected: validate-access-token body shape is recorded in A2a; per-role sign-in success is independently proven by the role-correct matrix behaviour in M1 (each actor session produced exactly the permission outcomes of its role) and memberships/current (manager 200, all other staff 403 per requireAgencyMemberRead Owner/Manager-only).
M3 reversal 400s were a harness payload defect: rentalPaymentController.reverse requires an idempotencyKey (8-200 chars). A2c completes the reversal with the proper payload.

A4 delete-car check was a harness artifact: A3a's control update-car sent the fixture payload (name "GAQ12B3 Test Hatch GT") against the MgrCar id, renaming the target, so A4's name-based lookup found nothing and its delete probe threw before dispatch. A4c re-proves manager delete-car by exact ID: 200, target gone (GET 204). All other A4 checks passed as recorded.

P3 verdict basis completed by A3c: after suspension, the sign-in endpoint still returns 200 with the user record, but validate-access-token returns 403 and agency calls (bookings, reports) return 403 on that session - access is revoked at the session/agency layer. The mechanic fixture was then deleted by exact ID (users keyword count 0, GET user 204).

P2 verdict basis: every staff role signed in through the real UI form and produced exactly its role-permission outcomes in the M1 matrix; memberships/current was 200 for manager and 403 for the other staff roles per requireAgencyMemberRead. validate-access-token returns a string body in this build (A2a), so the harness could not read type/_id from it - a harness parsing limit, not an auth failure.
